blocks.text: CARACAS — Maria Corina Machado, Venezuela’s opposition leader and a Nobel Peace Prize winner, made a surprise return home on Sunday after nearly a year in exile, drawing jubilant crowds in a direct challenge to the US-backed interim government. Thousands of people lined highways, toll plazas and city streets waving Venezuelan flags and chanting “Liberty!” as Machado entered Caracas in a convoy of cars and motorbikes. Wearing her trademark white T-shirt and blue jeans, she leaned through the sunroof of a vehicle to wave to the crowds and shake hands with her supporters.
